prompt_text: Where should I stay in Branson Missouri, an Airbnb or a hotel, and which specific places are best?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: it depends on what you want to do in Branson.

If your trip is show- and Strip-focused (convenience, dining, easy theater access) — pick a hotel on the 76 “Strip” or at Branson Landing. If you want relaxation, lake access, privacy or an outdoors/Ozarks vibe — a cabin or whole-home Airbnb near Table Rock Lake or in the Shepherd of the Hills area is usually better. Families who want pools/activities may prefer a resort or condo (hotel or condo-style rental) that has an indoor water park or multiple pools.

Below are recommendations and practical tips to help you choose.

Which to choose — pros/cons
- Hotel (best if: you want convenience, daily housekeeping, on-site restaurants/pools, front-desk help, theater/tour ticket assistance)
  - Pros: predictable quality, amenities (pools, restaurants, fitness), good locations for theaters and Branson Landing, easier late check-in and less responsibility.
  - Cons: smaller space, can be pricier per person, less privacy.
- Airbnb / vacation rental / cabin (best if: you want space, full kitchen, lakefront access, hot tub/cabin experience, lower cost for groups)
  - Pros: more space, kitchen to save money, unique properties (lake houses, cabins), good for groups and families.
  - Cons: variable quality, cleaning fees, sometimes farther from the Strip and attractions, host policies vary.

Where to stay by travel style (specific places people consistently like)
- Luxury / romantic / lake views
  - Chateau on the Lake Resort Spa & Convention Center — upscale, spa and lake views (good for couples).
  - Big Cedar Lodge (near Ridgedale/Table Rock Lake) — high-end Ozarks resort, great for outdoor activities and lake access.
- Families / resort amenities
  - Welk Resorts Branson (condo-style units, pools/activities) — family-friendly, often has indoor waterpark options nearby.
  - Grand Country Inn & Waterpark / Grand Crowne Resort (condo/resort style units with pools and water features).
- Convenient for shows and nightlife (76 Strip / Branson Landing)
  - Hotels on the 76 Strip or Branson Landing area — look for Hilton Promenade at Branson Landing or other full‑service hotels on or very near the Landing/Strip for walking access to shows, restaurants and shopping.
  - Hilton Branson Convention Center — convenient if you’re attending events or want central location.
- Budget-conscious / longer stays
  - Condo or home Airbnbs slightly off the Strip (Hollister, Branson West, Indian Point) — you’ll get more space and a kitchen for less per person.
- Nature / lake / cabin experience
  - Private cabins and lake houses on Table Rock Lake (Indian Point, Hollister, Kimberling City area) — look for listings with dock, deck, hot tub.
  - Small cabins in the Ozark hills near Shepherd of the Hills — great for hiking, zipline, and a quieter stay.

How to pick specific listings (quick checklist)
1. Prioritize location: Strip/Branson Landing for shows; Table Rock Lake/Indian Point for boating and sunsets.
2. Group size: large group = condo or Airbnb with multiple bedrooms; couple = boutique hotel or lakeside cabin.
3. Amenities: pool/waterpark, kitchen, free parking, laundry, hot tub.
4. Read recent reviews (last 3–6 months), check host cancellation policy and cleaning fee on Airbnbs.
5. Book early for peak season (summer, major show weeks, holidays).
6. If you plan lots of shows, check if the hotel offers ticket/tour desk or show packages.

Booking tips
- Compare total price (nightly rate + cleaning + service/taxes) for Airbnbs vs hotel taxes and resort fees.
- For family stays, condos often beat same-price hotel rooms because of kitchens and multiple bedrooms.
- If you want last-minute flexibility, hotels usually have easier change/cancellation policies than some Airbnb hosts.
- Ask Airbnb hosts about kayak/boat/dock access and parking if bringing a boat or trailer.

If you tell me:
- Your travel dates
- Who’s going (couple, family, group size)
- Top priorities (shows, lake, budget, pools, spa)
I’ll give a tailored short list of 3–5 specific properties (one hotel, one resort, and a few cabin/airbnb styles) that match your needs.
